correctness.rationale: All three digit-length/carry cases are exhaustive. Short inputs force (X^a-1)D(X)=X^k-1 and hence a|k; equal-length longer inputs force a fixed central digit by reflection of the carry-change interval; length growth is impossible because b>=3. Disjointness and independent-digit counts yield the exact formula for all b>=3, k>=1. Exact finite program checks 21 instances / 13287 pairs; finite checking is supplemental.

value.rationale: The paper’s Question 26 calls for understanding finite palindrome gap multiplicities. The complete exact two-parameter formula and classification for d=b^k in every nonbinary base identify distinct divisor and central-digit mechanisms and a sharp obstruction to binary extension. It has unlimited parameters and a natural fixed-gap counting purpose beyond merely checking small examples.
